inyenzi-ou-les-cafards: A small Rwandan village of mud-brick huts in dry bush country in the 1960s, a mother and a little girl seen from far behind carrying water jars along a red dirt path at dusk.
la-femme-aux-pieds-nus: Bare feet of a Rwandan woman walking on red earth between sorghum stalks, a woven basket on the ground and a round thatched hut in the distance.
l-iguifou: A thin little girl seen from behind searching the ground beside a thatched hut in Rwanda, a few sweet potatoes and a bowl of sorghum grains, dry hills under a pale sky.
ce-que-murmurent-les-collines: Green terraced Rwandan hills folding into the distance with a winding river at their foot, long-horned cows grazing and a woman seen from far away on a path.
coeur-tambour: A great carved African sacred drum on a dark concert stage under a spotlight, palm leaves and Caribbean sea waves in the background.
un-si-beau-diplome: A rolled diploma tied with a ribbon resting on an old suitcase on a dock, a ship and distant mountains, a young woman seen from behind walking away.

julienne: Two sisters seen from behind on a road leading out of the Rwandan hills toward a distant border post, then a grey European city skyline fading into the sky.

petit-pays-bd: A group of small boys seen from behind climbing a mango tree in a quiet residential cul-de-sac in Bujumbura, bicycles leaning against a wall, the lake and mountains in the distance.

cahier-nomade: A closed notebook on a wooden table next to a glass of tea, through the window an old cinema facade with blank walls and the Djibouti harbour at night.
balbala: A sprawling shantytown of corrugated metal shacks at the edge of Djibouti city, a lone runner seen from behind racing along a dusty track at dawn.
moisson-de-cranes: A quiet Rwandan hillside memorial with rows of simple wooden crosses and purple flowers, a writer seen from far behind standing in silence, misty hills.

rift-routes-rails: A railway line crossing the great Rift Valley with an old steam train, escarpments and acacia trees, a road winding beside it toward the horizon.
transit: A vast airport terminal with big windows and parked planes, two men seen from behind sitting on plastic chairs, one older and one young, small bags at their feet.

la-divine-chanson: A cat sitting on a piano in a smoky jazz club, a singer seen from behind at a microphone under a spotlight, a crossroads of city streets glimpsed through a window.
mon-nom-est-aube: Dawn rising over the desert of the Horn of Africa, prayer beads on a small carpet, a white mosque silhouette on the horizon.
pourquoi-tu-danses-quand-tu-marches: A father and a little girl seen from behind walking hand in hand on a Paris street, the father limping slightly, a dreamlike vision of a sunny Djibouti neighbourhood with a water tower above them.

quand-on-n-a-que-la-terre: A cupped pair of hands holding a small ball of earth with a sprouting plant, animals and trees around, a cracked dry land on one side and green land on the other.
notre-france-noire: A collage evoking Black history in France: a Paris rooftop skyline, a jazz trumpet, a feathered cabaret costume on a stand, a football and a tricolor ribbon.
rue-la-poudriere: A narrow street of poor wooden and tin houses in old Port-Louis at night, a young woman seen from behind under a single street lamp, mountains dark in the background.

l-arbre-fouet: A strange twisted tree with whip-like branches by a still dark lake in Mauritius, a woman seen from far behind sitting at its roots under a low moon.
moi-l-interdite: A lonely girl seen from behind sitting on the ground beside a large faithful dog near a shed, a closed house with lit windows in the distance.
pagli: A Mauritian village by the sea with a red earth path, a woman in a sari seen from behind running toward a fisherman's boat on the beach, cane fields behind.
soupir: A bare windswept plateau on the rocky island of Rodrigues, a few makeshift shelters, small figures seen from far away, a pale turquoise sea below.
le-long-desir: The shape of an island in a turquoise sea formed by the flowing folds of a red sari, sugar cane and frangipani flowers growing on it, a woman's long black hair seen from behind merging with the waves.
la-vie-de-josephin-le-fou: A lone man seen from behind standing waist-deep in a Mauritian lagoon at sunset, a small wooden pirogue and an octopus spear, rocks and waves.
indian-tango: A rooftop in New Delhi at night with festive strings of plain colored flags, two women seen from behind dancing a tango among potted plants, city lights.
le-sari-vert: A green sari draped over a wooden chair beside an empty sickbed with white sheets in a dim Mauritian house, three women seen from behind standing in the doorway.
les-hommes-qui-me-parlent: A writing desk with a closed notebook and fountain pen by an open window, shadowy silhouettes of several men standing in the garden outside at dusk.
quand-la-nuit-consent-a-me-parler: A dark night sky with a crescent moon and a sharp blade of light cutting through, a woman seen from behind at a window, stars falling like sparks.
les-jours-vivants: Portobello Road in London on a grey day with colorful terraced houses and market stalls, an elderly woman with a cane and a young man seen from far behind walking apart.
l-ambassadeur-triste: A grand empty embassy salon with a chandelier and a lone armchair, a tall window opening onto an Indian city street with rickshaws and colored awnings.
ceux-du-large: A small overcrowded boat seen from far away on a vast dark sea at night, a lighthouse on a distant shore, waves rising.
manger-l-autre: A huge table covered with cakes, pots and dishes in a small kitchen, a teenage girl seen from behind sitting alone, smartphones glowing in the dark window.
danser-sur-tes-braises: A woman seen from behind dancing barefoot on glowing embers, her shadow shaped like her mother.
fardo: Museum display cases in a dark gallery: an ancient wrapped pre-Columbian mummy bundle and a few bronze ornaments, a woman seen from behind contemplating them.
le-rire-des-deesses: A crowded holy river bank in Benares with steps leading down to the Ganges, marigolds and oil lamps floating, two women seen from behind pushing through the pilgrims.
sylvia-p: A snowy London street in winter with a terraced house, a typewriter on a table by a window, bare trees and bees in a glass jar.
le-jour-des-cameleons: A large chameleon on a branch overlooking a Mauritian town with smoke rising from a burning shopping mall, mountains and a lagoon under a red sky.
la-nuit-s-ajoute-a-la-nuit: An old prison courtyard at night with high stone walls, barred windows and a single lit cell, a woman seen from behind standing alone under the stars.

les-rochers-de-poudre-d-or: A sailing ship approaching the rocky coast of Mauritius in the 1890s, Indian workers seen from behind on deck with bundles, sugar cane fields on the hills.
blue-bay-palace: A luxury beach hotel with palm trees and a turquoise lagoon in Mauritius, a young woman in a staff uniform seen from behind looking at the sea at dusk.
la-noce-d-anna: A wedding reception in a garden with lanterns and long tables, a mother seen from behind standing apart watching a bride in white far away.
le-dernier-frere: Two small boys seen from behind on either side of a barbed-wire fence in a tropical prison camp in Mauritius, tall trees and heavy rain clouds.
en-attendant-demain: A country house in southwest France beside a lake with a painter's easel on the lawn, a woman seen from behind holding a child's hand by the water.
petit-eloge-des-fantomes: Translucent ghostly white shapes drifting gently through a tropical island house: an empty picture frame, a cooking pot, palm trees bending under a cyclone, soft and gentle.
une-annee-lumiere: A wall with twelve small arched windows each showing a different scene: an island, a boat of migrants, a library, a grandmother's kitchen, glowing with warm light.
le-ciel-par-dessus-le-toit: A blue sky above the high wall and roof of a prison, a single tree branch swaying over the wall, a mother and a girl seen from behind outside the gate.
rien-ne-t-appartient: A widow seen from behind standing in a quiet modern house, and behind a glass door a vision of a small girl seen from behind in a tropical Asian landscape with palm trees and a ruined school.
la-memoire-delavee: An old wooden table with a closed faded photo album and a brass lamp, through the window a sugar cane field and a ship sailing from India, in sepia tones.
la-nuit-au-coeur: Three women seen from behind walking separately along a dark road at night, a single streetlight and a small heart-shaped glow in the sky.
la-coupe-de-cendres: An antique cup filled with grey ashes on a carved wooden table, a view of the hills of old Tananarive with royal palaces in the background.
sylves: A dense tropical forest of Madagascar with ferns and orchids, a lyre made of branches leaning against a tree trunk, soft morning light.
volumes: A stack of old leather-bound books in a colonial library in Tananarive, a window showing red-brick houses and the hills of the Malagasy highlands.
traduit-de-la-nuit: A dreamlike Malagasy highland night: rice paddies reflecting the moon, a black cow and a bird flying across a starry sky, silhouettes of houses.
vieilles-chansons-des-pays-d-imerina: Two young people seen from far away facing each other on a hill of the Imerina highlands, rice terraces, zebu cattle and traditional houses with steep roofs.

lucarne: A small skylight window above a dark alley of Antananarivo, a barefoot boy seen from behind running between crowded houses and stairways, red sunset.
reves-sous-le-linceul: A white shroud floating like a cloud over a Malagasy shantytown by marshes, dream images of birds, fish and baobabs appearing inside the shroud.
l-arbre-anthropophage: A giant mythical tree with tangled roots devouring an old radio and blank paper sheets, on a red Malagasy hill, small figures seen from far away.
madagascar-1947: Old sepia landscape of eastern Madagascar forest in 1947, small figures of insurgents seen from far away walking with spears among tall trees, smoke on the horizon.
za: A ragged man seen from behind walking on a beach of a dark island, followed at a distance by a woman, giant crumbling stone thrones and heavy golden clouds above.
les-cauchemars-du-gecko: A gecko on a wall watching a distant glittering Western city through a window, a poor Malagasy room with a candle and bare walls.
portraits-d-insurges: Old empty wooden frames and a woven mat hanging on a wall in a village house, elderly hands resting on a walking stick in the foreground, green hills outside.
revenir: A man seen from far behind struggling in the waves off a Corsican beach with mountains, and in the sky above a dreamlike vision of Malagasy hills and a childhood house.
tisser: A great woven tapestry of Malagasy patterns with threads forming rivers, stars and hills, a marovany harp leaning against the loom.
mon-etincelle: A small airplane flying through stormy turbulence above the Comoros islands and a turquoise sea, a spark of light trailing behind it.
derange-que-je-suis: A busy port in Anjouan with a ferry docked, a poor docker seen from behind pushing a battered handcart loaded with bags and parcels.
jouissance: A battered plain paperback book with a blank cover and wings flying over overflowing trash cans, a library shelf and an empty stage with a red theatre curtain, comic and theatrical.
ejo: A jacaranda tree in full purple bloom over a Rwandan path, one side bathed in the light of the past and the other in a dawn of tomorrow, a woman seen from behind.
consolee: A quiet care home garden in southwest France with an old woman in a wheelchair seen from behind, and drifting from her a vision of a Rwandan hill with coral trees and a mission building.
peau-d-epice: A little girl seen from behind among fruit trees full of mangoes, papayas and avocados, spices and colorful fruits around her, playful and bright.
culbuter-le-malheur: A woman seen from behind pushing over a large dark boulder rolling down a hill, revealing flowers and light underneath, Rwandan hills.
le-convoi: A line of white buses and trucks seen from far away on a winding road through Rwandan hills in 1994, children's hands at the windows, smoke in the distance.
la-solidarite-des-ebranles: A crowd of activists seen from behind with raised fists and plain red banners in a sunny South African street, red ribbons floating above them.
